Joshua, saw Kinective shipped SignPlus Gateway with a new BI dashboard and licensed Gateway to PayNearMe this year.

As the platform expands, the bottleneck usually moves to signal-to-action latency: more in-market accounts surface than the team can route and act on fast enough, and pipeline leaks in the gap. Our AI SDR turns signals into researched, written, followed-up outreach automatically, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Kinective off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?

Joshua, quick follow-up for Kinective.

Most RevOps teams can surface intent but can't act on it fast enough, and data hygiene plus manual routing slow everything down. Tighter 75-100 word emails alone lift response rates 67% in our data, and the worker keeps every send logged clean to CRM.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three changes I'd make first to cut that latency, with the measurable lift to expect.
